title: Verify the fee/discount template library is at Administration → Service → Fees & Discounts (below Canned Lines)
custom_steps:
1. Open Administration (the gear/admin area).
2. In the left menu, look under the 'SERVICE' heading.
3. Click 'Fees & Discounts'.
custom_expected:
1. A 'Fees & Discounts' page opens.
2. In the left menu it sits under 'SERVICE', directly below 'Canned Lines'.
